Benighat temple is not a designated evacuation point, so the only drop-off is Myagang shelter. The young woman at Syaphru school counts as an adult. Syaphru is a dead end reached only via Myagang, so a round trip there costs 36 minutes, more than the 20-minute penalty for deferring her. The plan below rescues everyone else in 126 driving minutes. I assumed roads can be driven in either direction.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 nilkantha-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 myagang-shelter bidur-village
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 bidur-village myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 myagang-shelter nilkantha-market
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 nilkantha-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 2
defer syaphru-school adult 1
</plan>

COST: 146
